name: The Swordbearer
source:
Take on the role of a young adventurer who recently inherited a sword. Your journey starts after you apply to the Knights Guild at the capital. Meet loveable characters as you explore this world that awaits you. Face the darkness that surfaces and uncover the evil plot as your story progresses.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1998050/The_Swordbearer__Season_1/]Steam[/url]]
